en: A sepia-toned historical photograph shows a large group of people gathered in a public square. In the foreground, there are several mounted soldiers, some on white horses, wearing uniforms and caps. In the center, a small group of dignitaries or officials stands on a circular platform while a crowd watches from the background. Visible signage in German is attached to a lamppost, and the crowd includes both civilians and military personnel. The image has a vintage feel, possibly from the early 20th century.
